title: The fractal geometry of opinion formation
summary: In this manuscript, we introduce and study a variant of the agent-based opinion dynamics proposed in a recent work [9], within the framework of an interacting multi-agent system, where agents are assumed to interact with each other and update their opinions after each pairwise encounter. Specifically, our opinion model involves a large crowd of $N$ indistinguishable agents, each characterized by an opinion value ranging within the interval $[-1,1]$.
